name: Mrs. Gustavsson
source:
Mrs. Gustavsson is the proud mother of [url=/c176664]Carl "Gus the Bus" Gustavsson[/url]. She is under the impression that her son is an outstanding individual and a valued member of the local community. (He's a criminal.) Married young to her high school sweetheart and widowed by war. Her husband served as a fighter pilot but was shot down over the jungles of enemy territory. Considered M.I.A. Mrs. Gustavsson is sweet, a little crazy, and in dire need of attention.

[Edited from in-game description]
